Here is the complete, ordered sequence for `POST /api/owners` — it is handled by `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` (`OwnerFieldsDto`, optional `Idempotency-Key` header). I've split it into the request‑binding phase (which runs before the method body) and the controller body, and marked each step as a **validation** (can reject the request) or a **side‑effect** (mutates the owner/DTO, writes state, or logs).

## Phase 1 — Security (before anything else)

1. **Validation — authorization.** `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")`. Without the `OWNER_ADMIN` role the request is rejected (403) before the body is touched.

## Phase 2 — Request-body binding & `@Valid` (before the method body runs)

These run while Spring resolves the `OwnerFieldsDto` argument. The bean-validation constraints and the two `@InitBinder`-registered validators (`OwnerFieldsValidator`, then `RegistrationDateValidator`) all contribute field errors to the same `Errors`; any error → 400.

2. **Validation — Bean Validation constraints on the DTO** (`OwnerFieldsDto` getters): `firstName` `@NotNull`, letters-only `@Pattern`, `@Size(1..30)`; `lastName` `@NotNull`, `@Pattern`, `@Size(1..30)`; `city` `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..80)`; `telephone` `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..20)`; `address` `@Size(1..255)`; `addressLine1`/`addressLine2` `@Size(max 255)`; `email` `@Size(max 255)`. `title` must be one of `MR/MRS/MS/DR`.

Then `OwnerFieldsValidator.validate` runs, in this order:

3. **Side-effect — address canonicalization.** If `addressLine1` is non-blank, `addressLine1`/`addressLine2` are normalized and written back, and `address` is composed as `line1 [+ " " + line2]`. Otherwise the flat `address` is normalized and written back.
4. **Validation — address required.** After canonicalization, if `address` is null/blank → field error on `address`.
5. **Validation — required text fields.** `firstName`, `lastName`, `city`, `telephone` rejected if empty/whitespace.
6. **Side-effect + validation — telephone.** Only if `telephone` has no prior error: normalize to E.164 and write it back; if it can't be normalized → field error `telephone.invalid`.
7. **Validation + side-effect — email** (only when supplied): must be syntactically valid (`email.invalid`), must not be a disposable domain (`email.disposable`); if valid, it is normalized to lower case and written back.
8. **Validation — postcode** (only when supplied): must be valid for the owner's `city` per the fixed region ranges, else `postcode.invalid`.

Then `RegistrationDateValidator.validate`:

9. **Validation — registration date not in the future.** If a `registrationDate` was supplied and it is after the server's current date → `registrationDate.future`.

## Phase 3 — Controller body (`addOwner`), in execution order

10. **Side-effect (short-circuit) — idempotency replay.** If an `Idempotency-Key` header is present and already known in `IdempotentOwnerStore`, the previously created owner is re-read and returned (200 OK); nothing below runs.
11. **Side-effect — map DTO → `Owner`** (`ownerMapper.toOwner`): copies the (now canonicalized) fields into a new transient `Owner`.
12. **Side-effect — assign registration date** (`RegistrationDateAssigner`): defaults to the server's current date when none supplied, then rolls weekends/public holidays forward to the next business day; writes back the adjusted date.
13. **Validation — city capacity** (`CityCapacityChecker`): if the city already holds ≥ 50 owners → 409 CONFLICT.
14. **Validation — daily registration limit** (`DailyRegistrationLimiter`): if ≥ 100 owners already carry this (adjusted) registration date → 429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.
15. **Side-effect — assign household id** (`HouseholdAssigner`): deterministic id derived from normalized last name + postcode; written to the owner.
16. **Validation — household duplicate** (`HouseholdDuplicateChecker`): if another owner already shares the household **and** the request did not set `sharesHousehold=true` → 409 CONFLICT. (When `sharesHousehold=true`, the owner is recorded internally as a *declared household member* for step 22.)
17. **Validation — identity duplicate** (`IdentityDuplicateChecker`): if any non-deleted owner has the same identity key (telephone|email|householdId) → 409 CONFLICT.
18. **Side-effect — assign household size** (`HouseholdSizeAssigner`): count of stored owners sharing the household + 1 (or 1 if no household).
19. **Side-effect — assign customer code** (`CustomerCodeAssigner`): `<REGION>-<HASH8>` from region + SHA-256 of telephone+lastName, de-duplicated with a `-<n>` suffix against existing codes.
20. **Side-effect — assign namesake count** (`NamesakeCounter`): number of existing owners with the same first+last name (case-insensitive).
21. **Side-effect — assign membership points & level** (`MembershipLevelAssigner`): tallies points (email, no namesakes, large household; tenure is always 0 on create) and bands into level 1–4.
22. **Side-effect — assign bulk-signup warning** (`BulkSignupWarningAssigner`): `true` if > 80 owners already carry this registration date.
23. **Side-effect — assign possible-duplicate flag** (`PossibleDuplicateAssigner` / `PossibleDuplicateMatcher`): unless the owner is a declared household member, soft-match (same last name + postcode, different telephone) sets `possibleDuplicate` and `possibleDuplicateOf` to the earliest match's id.
24. **Side-effect — persist** (`clinicService.saveOwner`): the owner is saved and assigned its id.
25. **Side-effect — remember idempotency key** (`IdempotentOwnerStore.remember`): if a key was supplied, store `key → owner.id`.
26. **Side-effect — audit log** (`OwnerCreationAuditLogger.logCreated`): writes one line to the `AUDIT` logger with id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel, membershipNumber.
27. **Side-effect — build response**: map to `OwnerDto`, set the `Location` header to `/api/owners/{id}`, return 201 CREATED.

A few things worth calling out: the duplicate/identity checks (16–17) and all the count-based assigners (13–14, 18–23) read the *pre-save* store, so they never count the owner itself; deleted owners are excluded from the household and identity checks. Many response fields (`salutation`, `ageBand`, `fiscalYear`, `membershipNumber`, `checkDigit`, `region`/`locality`/`timezone`, `telephoneDisplay`, `identityKey`) are **not** assigned here — they're derived on read in the `Owner` model / mapper, so they aren't creation side-effects.

9. **Validation — registration date not in the future.** If a `registrationDate` was supplied and it is after the server's current date → `registrationDate.future`.

## Phase 3 — Controller body (`addOwner`), in execution order

10. **Side-effect (short-circuit) — idempotency replay.** If an `Idempotency-Key` header is present and already known in `IdempotentOwnerStore`, the previously created owner is re-read and returned (200 OK); nothing below runs.
11. **Side-effect — map DTO → `Owner`** (`ownerMapper.toOwner`): copies the (now canonicalized) fields into a new transient `Owner`.
12. **Side-effect — assign registration date** (`RegistrationDateAssigner`): defaults to the server's current date when none supplied, then rolls weekends/public holidays forward to the next business day; writes back the adjusted date.
13. **Validation — city capacity** (`CityCapacityChecker`): if the city already holds ≥ 50 owners → 409 CONFLICT.
14. **Validation — daily registration limit** (`DailyRegistrationLimiter`): if ≥ 100 owners already carry this (adjusted) registration date → 429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.
15. **Side-effect — assign household id** (`HouseholdAssigner`): deterministic id derived from normalized last name + postcode; written to the owner.
16. **Validation — household duplicate** (`HouseholdDuplicateChecker`): if another owner already shares the household **and** the request did not set `sharesHousehold=true` → 409 CONFLICT. (When `sharesHousehold=true`, the owner is recorded internally as a *declared household member* for step 22.)
17. **Validation — identity duplicate** (`IdentityDuplicateChecker`): if any non-deleted owner has the same identity key (telephone|email|householdId) → 409 CONFLICT.
18. **Side-effect — assign household size** (`HouseholdSizeAssigner`): count of stored owners sharing the household + 1 (or 1 if no household).
19. **Side-effect — assign customer code** (`CustomerCodeAssigner`): `<REGION>-<HASH8>` from region + SHA-256 of telephone+lastName, de-duplicated with a `-<n>` suffix against existing codes.
20. **Side-effect — assign namesake count** (`NamesakeCounter`): number of existing owners with the same first+last name (case-insensitive).
21. **Side-effect — assign membership points & level** (`MembershipLevelAssigner`): tallies points (email, no namesakes, large household; tenure is always 0 on create) and bands into level 1–4.
22. **Side-effect — assign bulk-signup warning** (`BulkSignupWarningAssigner`): `true` if > 80 owners already carry this registration date.
23. **Side-effect — assign possible-duplicate flag** (`PossibleDuplicateAssigner` / `PossibleDuplicateMatcher`): unless the owner is a declared household member, soft-match (same last name + postcode, different telephone) sets `possibleDuplicate` and `possibleDuplicateOf` to the earliest match's id.
24. **Side-effect — persist** (`clinicService.saveOwner`): the owner is saved and assigned its id.
25. **Side-effect — remember idempotency key** (`IdempotentOwnerStore.remember`): if a key was supplied, store `key → owner.id`.
26. **Side-effect — audit log** (`OwnerCreationAuditLogger.logCreated`): writes one line to the `AUDIT` logger with id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel, membershipNumber.
27. **Side-effect — build response**: map to `OwnerDto`, set the `Location` header to `/api/owners/{id}`, return 201 CREATED.

A few things worth calling out: the duplicate/identity checks (16–17) and all the count-based assigners (13–14, 18–23) read the *pre-save* store, so they never count the owner itself; deleted owners are excluded from the household and identity checks. Many response fields (`salutation`, `ageBand`, `fiscalYear`, `membershipNumber`, `checkDigit`, `region`/`locality`/`timezone`, `telephoneDisplay`, `identityKey`) are **not** assigned here — they're derived on read in the `Owner` model / mapper, so they aren't creation side-effects.
